 \- Develop and optimize AI/ML models for wearable applications, with a focus on computer vision and multimodal interfaces.

 \- Collaborate cross\-functionally with hardware engineers and product teams to define and refine AI capabilities.

 \- Engage with clients in related industries to understand their needs and integrate their feedback into model development.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 \- Strong experience in applied AI/ML, especially in computer vision and multimodal AI technologies.
 



 \- Proven track record in model orchestration, with a deep understanding of production environments and workflows.
 



 \- Familiarity with wearable technology and industrial applications.
 



 \- Experience in developing and optimizing production VLM pipelines.
